entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be connected.
Returns.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return something.
I can certainly help with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Alex Chen. Order 774-91B.
Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling that up now... I see an order for the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes delivered about 85 days ago. Is that the correct item?
Yes.
Okay. And to get this return started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They give me blisters. They just don't fit right.

I'm sorry to hear that. Discomfort is definitely not what we aim for. Just to be thorough, did you try adjusting the cleats or using different insoles? Sometimes a small adjustment can make a big difference.
Whatever. I just want my money back. Your policy says 90 days, and it's been less than that.
You are absolutely correct. One moment while I confirm that for you... Yes, I see you're at 85 days, which is well within our 90-day return window. I can definitely process a full refund for you.
Fine.

I've just approved the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address we have on file. As soon as we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be issued to the original payment method.
Great. I guess I have to take my cleats off them first.
Yes, please. We do ask that they are returned without any attachments. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Alex?
No.
Alright. Well, thank you for your call. I hope we can find a better-fitting product for you in the future. Have a good rest of your day.
